# Zones by expansion

Every zone in the RoF2 client's zone table (522 zones), with its short name (the name the server and the
game folder's zone files use) and its id. Zones are grouped by the expansion the client gives each one and sorted
by long name, ignoring a leading "The".

The expansion is the client's own (`EQWorldData::ExpansionZone`), not a release history, so:

- Classic is the default and also holds test and developer zones, housing interiors and some later remakes
  (`commonlands`, `befallenb`).
- Lost Dungeons of Norrath lists every adventure instance, not only the camps.
- Names are spelled as the client spells them ("BlackBurrow", "HighKeep").

The list is regenerated with `tools/gen_zone_list.py > docs/zones.md` whenever `src/game/zone_names.inc` changes.
